questions.q: A solution is prepared by adding& $2g$~of~$' ' X ''$~to~$1$~mole of water. Mass percent of~$'' X ''$in solution is&
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
To calculate the mass percent of ''X'' in the solution, we need to determine the mass of ''X'' and the total mass of the solution.

Given:

:Solute ($X$) = $2g$

Solvent (${H}_{2}O$)$= 1mole = 18g$

Total mass $= 2 + 18 = 20g$

~Mass percent of~$X = \dfrac{2}{2 + 18} \times 100 = 10$

questions.q: Complete combustion of $1 . 80g$ of an oxygen containing compound  \left({C}_{x}{H}_{y}{O}_{z}\right)$ gave $2 . 64g$ of ${CO}_{2}$ and $1 . 08g$ of ${H}_{2}O .$ The percentage of oxygen in the organic compound is :$
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
${n}_{CO2} = \dfrac{2 . 64}{44} = 0 . 06$

${n}_{c} = 0 . 06$

weight of carbon $= 0 . 06 \times 12 = 0 . 72gm$

${n}_{{H}_{2}O} = \dfrac{1 . 08}{18} = 0 . 06$

${n}_{H} = 0 . 06 \times 2 = 0 . 12$

~weight of $H = 0 . 12gm$

$= 1 . 8 - ( 0 . 72 + 0 . 12 )$

$= 0 . 96gram$

~$%$ weight of oxygen $= \dfrac{0 . 96}{1 . 8} \times 100$

The percentage of oxygen in the organic compound~$= 53 . 3 %$.

questions.q:
Mass of magnesium required to produce 220 mL of hydrogen gas at STP on reaction with excess of dil. HCl is
Given : Molar mass of Mg is $24 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1}$.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{Mg}+2 \mathrm{HCl} \rightarrow \mathrm{MgCl}_2+\mathrm{H}_2$
Volume $\mathrm{H}_2$ evolved $=220 \mathrm{ml}$
Mole of $\mathrm{H}_2=\frac{220 \times 10^{-3}}{22.4}=$ mole of Mg used
$\begin{aligned}
\therefore \text { Mass of Mg used } & =\frac{220 \times 10^{-3}}{22.4} \times 24 \\
& =235.7 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{gm} \\
& =235.7 \mathrm{mg}
\end{aligned}$

questions.q: Hemoglobin contains $0 . 34 %$ of iron by mass. The number of $Fe$ atoms in $3 . 3g$ of hemoglobin is (Given : Atomic mass of Fe is $56u, {N}_{A}$ in$6 . 022 \times {10}^{23}{mol}^{- 1}$)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Mass of haemoglobin =& $3 . 3g$

Mass of iron atoms =~$\dfrac{0 . 34}{100} \times 3 . 3 = 0 . 01122g$

$56g$of iron contains = $1$~mole of iron or $6 . 023 \times {10}^{23}$ atoms

Number of moles of atoms=$\dfrac{Mass}{atomicmass}$

Number of moles of~$0 . 01122g$~of iron is

Number of moles =~$\dfrac{0 . 01122g}{56g} = 0 . 00020$~moles

Number of atoms =Number of moles~$\times$avogadro number

No. of $Fe$ atoms

~$= 0 . 00020 \times 6 . 022 \times {10}^{23} = 1 . 2046 \times {10}^{20}$

questions.q: The average molar mass of chlorine is& $35 . 5g{mol}^{- 1}$. The ratio of~$Cl 35$~to~$Cl 37$& in naturally occurring chlorine is close to :

questions.solution:
$\begin{cases}35CI & 37CI \\ Molarratio & x & 1 - x\end{cases}$

So, ratio of~$35CI{:}^{37}CI = 3: 1$

questions.q:
Concentrated nitric acid is labelled as $75 \%$ by mass. The volume in mL of the solution which contains 30 g of nitric acid is ____.
Given : Density of nitric acid solution is $1.25 \mathrm{~g} / \mathrm{mL}$.
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
$75 \%$ by mass means :
$\because \quad 75 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{HNO}_3$ in 100 g solution.
$\therefore \quad 30 \mathrm{~g} \mathrm{HNO}_3$ in $\frac{100}{75} \times 30 \mathrm{~g}$ solution.
$\begin{aligned}
& \mathrm{m}_{\text {solution }}=\frac{100 \times 30}{75} \mathrm{~g} \\
\because \quad & \mathrm{~V}_{\text {sol }}=\frac{\mathrm{m}_{\text {sol }}}{\mathrm{d}_{\text {sol }}}=\frac{100 \times 30}{75 \times 1.25}=32 \mathrm{~mL}
\end{aligned}$

questions.q: ${SO}_{2}{Cl}_{2}$ on reaction with excess of water results into acidic mixture~${SO}_{2}{Cl}_{2} + 2{H}_{2}O \to {H}_{2}{SO}_{4} + 2HCl$~$16$~moles of $NaOH$ is required for the complete neutralisation of the resultant acidic mixture. The number of moles of ${SO}_{2}{Cl}_{2}$ used is
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
${SO}_{2}{Cl}_{2} + 2{H}_{2}O \to 2HCl + {H}_{2}{SO}_{4}$

Let $x$~moles of ${SO}_{2}{Cl}_{2}$ are required,

$∴ n\left({H}_{2}{SO}_{4}\right) = x, n\left(HCl\right) = 2x$

$⇒ n\left(H^{+}\right) = 4x$

Moles of $H^{+}$~formed $= 4x$

Moles of~${OH}^{-}$~from $16$~moles of $NaOH = 16$

$4x = 16$ (for complete neutralisation)

$x = 4$

questions.q:
A sample of ${CaCO}_{3}$ and ${MgCO}_{3}$ weighed $2 .21 g$ is ignited to constant weight of $1 .152 g$. The composition of the mixture is:

(Given molar mass in $g{mol}^{- 1}$,~${CaCO}_{3}: 100, {MgCO}_{3}: 84$)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
$CaC{O}_{3} \left(s\right)\overset{Δ}{→}CaO \left($s\right) + $C{O}_{2}\left($g\right)$

$MgC{O}_{3} \left(s\right)\overset{Δ}{→}MgO \left($s\right) + $C{O}_{2}\left($g\right)$

Let the weight of $CaC{O}_{3}$ be $xgm$

$∴$ weight of $MgC{O}_{3} = \left($2 .21 - x\right)gm$

Moles of $CaC{O}_{3}$ decomposed = moles of $CaO$ formed

$\dfrac{x}{100} =$moles of $CaO$ formed

$∴$ weight of $CaO$ formed $= \dfrac{x}{100} \times56$
Moles of $MgC{O}_{3}$ decomposed = moles of $MgO$ formed

\left($2 .21 - x\right)84 =$ moles of $MgO$ formed

$∴$ weight of $MgO$ formed $= \dfrac{2 .21 - x}{84} \times40⇒ \dfrac{2 .21 - x}{84} \times40 + \dfrac{x}{100} \times56 = 1 .152$

$∴ x = 1 .187 g =$ weight of $CaC{O}_{3}$ and weight of $MgC{O}_{3} = 1 .023 g$

$

$= 7 . 527 \times {10}^{22}$

questions.q: The moles of methane required to produce $81g$ of water after complete combustion is____\times {10}^{- 2}mol. [nearest integer]
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
${CH}_{4} + 2{O}_{2} ⟶ {CO}_{2} + 2{H}_{2}O$

POAC on H atom

${nCH}_{4} \times 4 = {nH}_{2}O \times 2$

${nCH}_{4} = \dfrac{81}{18} \times 2 \times \dfrac{1}{4} = \dfrac{81}{36}$

${nCH}_{4} = 2 . 25$

$= 225 \times {10}^{- 2}$

Hence, the number of moles of methane is~$225 \times {10}^{- 2}$

questions.q:
Zinc reacts with hydrochloric acid to give hydrogen and zinc chloride. The volume of hydrogen gas produced at STP from the reaction of $11 . 5g$ of zinc with excess $HCl$ is $L$ (Nearest integer)
(Given : Molar mass of $Zn$ is $65 . 4g{mol}^{- 1}$ and Molar volume of ${H}_{2}$~at $STP = 22 . 7L$ )
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Zinc reacts with hydrochloric acid to give hydrogen and zinc chloride.

$Zn + 2HCl \to {ZnCl}_{2} + {H}_{2} ↑$

The molar mass of~$Zn$~is~$65 . 4$~g mol-1

Molar volume od ${H}_{2}$~at STP =~$22 . 7$~L

Number of moles of~$Zn$~$= \dfrac{11 . 5}{65 . 4} =$~Number of moles of ${H}_{2}$evolved~

Volume of${H}_{2} = \dfrac{11 . 5}{65 . 4} \times 22 . 7L = 3 . 99L \approx 4L$

questions.q:
$0 . 05cm$ thick coating of silver is deposited on a plate of $0 . 05m^{2}$ area. The number of silver atoms deposited on plate are _______\times {10}^{23}$. (At mass Ag \left= 108, d = 7 . 9g{cm}^{- 3}\right)$ Round off to the nearest integer.

$$
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Volume of silver coating $= 0 . 05 \times 0 . 05 \times 10000 = 25{cm}^{3}$

Given, Density =$7 . 9g{cm}^{- 3}$

Density = Mass/ Volume

Mass of silver deposited $= 25 \times 7 . 9g$

Moles of silver atoms = mass / molar mass $= \dfrac{25 \times 7 . 9}{108}$

Number of silver atoms $= \dfrac{25 \times 7 . 9}{108} \times 6 . 023 \times {10}^{23}$

$= 11 . 01 \times {10}^{23}$

Ans. $11$
